detail.rangeCaption: Sep 22 complete session · 63 usable / 80 source shots. Twelve distance-dash rows excluded from all metrics, then five clear mishits held out. Both 5i targets stay separate.
detail.story:
5-IRON TARGET 165 — CONTROL THE CURVE. All fourteen distance-bearing shots stay. Mean path −3.0° (left), face +0.3° (right of target) and face-to-path +3.3° (open). Nine of fourteen faces are open to path. Next block: watch whether the path spread narrows and the face-to-path gap shrinks. Carry averaged 149.1 yd versus 179.1 total; best-five carry 165.4 yd is the ceiling of this batch, not a new stock yardage.

7-IRON — TRACK CARRY CONSISTENCY. Fourteen usable shots average 133.5 carry / 160.8 total; best-five carry 149.5 yd. The 96.1–153.4 yd carry range remains after the established filter. Shot 7 had no distance and contributes nothing to the averages. Review the retained-shot face/path chart rather than the original fifteen-shot screen average.

56° — PRACTICE THE LANDING DISTANCE. 83.6 carry / 92.1 total against a 92-yard target. All six finished in the total target zone but only two carried into it. Carries ranged 73.9–94.3 yd. Best-five carry 85.5 yd. For a green or forced carry, choose the landing distance deliberately; the simulator finish cannot substitute for carry.

3-WOOD — THE FINISH OVERSTATES THE CARRY. All seven remain: 177.7 carry / 223.2 total; best-five carry 182.8 yd. Launch averaged 9.5° with −2.5° attack angle. The 223-yard simulated finish is not evidence of a 223-yard forced carry. Track launch and carry together on the next comparable block.

5-WOOD — SEVEN USABLE SHOTS. Four distance-dash rows are excluded from every metric, and the 112.6-yard shot is below the clear-mishit cutoff. Remaining carry 174.7 / total 207.2; best-five carry 188.3 yd. The 147.5 and 134.0 attempts stay because they are above the cutoff. This block overlaps the 3W in carry despite a shorter total: assess actual carry gaps before making a bag change.

5-IRON TARGET 170 — CONTACT LOSSES AND DIRECTION ARE DIFFERENT PROBLEMS. Seven distance-dash rows contribute nothing. Four clear short shots (92.0, 77.6, 97.0 and 86.3 carry) are held out of both distance and delivery analysis. Fifteen remain: 153.9 carry / 187.4 total; best-five carry 168.2 yd. Keep this separate from target 165 so the two delivery patterns remain visible. One retained shot has off-screen delivery readings, so that metric uses fourteen rather than inventing a fifteenth reading.
detail.limits: Complete review of the 80 source shot rows. Per Jack’s instruction, twelve rows with both carry and total dashes are excluded entirely from live tables, charts and all metrics. Five additional clear short shots are held out using the established two-thirds cluster-median rule. Raw source transcripts preserve all 80 for audit. Some 5i target-170 shot 11 delivery/strike fields were off-screen; per-metric n reflects that. Original TrackMan AVG rows include excluded shots and remain source history only. No outdoor stock distances are changed. Ball marking and normalization were not shown; numeric spin/impact readings are transcribed without independently verifying measurement status. FILM NONE.
